scope: Formal closure specification and fixed-Q/fixed-continuation market validation; NOT a full stochastic equilibrium solver.

derived_checks_by_representation.note: Reduced form uses E27 as R7, reconstructs E22 positions and checks E26. Original form imposes E22/E26 and checks E27. Never impose both clearing representations independently.

recovered_production_multipliers: For K_e>0 and R1 satisfied: lambda=max(P-MC_d,0), mu_Q=max(MC_d-P,0); substitute lambda into E13; not additional free functions.
recovered_positions: For v>0: hI=-alpha_I*I+wI*H, hD=C+wD*H, hf=wf*H; H=alpha_I*I-C; wi=(1/ai)/T.
zero_variance: Require F=mu for bounded financial choice; positions not unique; displayed shares are a continuous-limit selection only.

expectation_sources.mean_price: same P policy evaluated on Phi(s,G(s),epsilon)
expectation_sources.future_production: same Q policy and same Phi/Pi
expectation_sources.future_shadow_values: same W policies and same Phi/Pi

admissibility: nonempty policy-invariant state domain almost surely
no-bubble shadow values and appropriate transversality
no clipping of invalid quantities or prices
investment_sufficient_convexity: chi > 2*omega_B*sum(beta**(k/2) for k=1..L-1); sufficient, not necessary; omega_B=0 restricted baseline
state_dimension: n_z + L + R + 3; n_z=5 gives L+R+8
